2607.29246.title: Don't Mix Rewards, Mix Policies: Policy Decomposition and Optimization for Multi-Reward RL
2607.29246.paper_summary: Modern large language models (LLMs) are expected not just to answer correctly, but to adapt their behavior to different human values and use cases. As a result, multi-reward reinforcement learning (RL) has become an increasingly important problem for LLMs, where each reward captures a different aspect of desired behavior. However, optimizing with multiple rewards suffers from a more severe alignment tax issue, where different optimization objectives can trade off or even conflict with each other, leading to unstable and inefficient post-training. In this work, we propose PRISM, a new multi-reward RL framework built upon the idea of policy-space decomposition and composition. Instead of compositing different rewards, PRISM optimizes a set of standalone positive policies and a global negative policy. This alleviates the potential conflict during multi-reward policy optimization, while enabling controllability during inference by flexible policy composition. Experiments on scientific reasoning, tool-use reasoning, and helpfulness-safety alignment show that PRISM consistently outperforms existing multi-reward RL baselines, with extra controllability for inference-time preference control.
2607.29246.paper_summary_zh: 現代的大型語言模型（LLMs）不僅被期望能正確回答問題，還應該能夠根據不同的人類價值觀和使用情境調整其行為。<lb/>因此，多獎勵強化學習（RL）已成為LLMs日益重要的問題，其中每個獎勵捕捉到所需行為的不同方面。<lb/>然而，使用多個獎勵進行優化會面臨更嚴重的對齊稅問題，不同的優化目標之間可能會相互權衡甚至衝突，導致訓練後不穩定且效率低下。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們提出了PRISM，一個基於政策空間分解和組合思想的新多獎勵RL框架。<lb/>PRISM不是將不同的獎勵進行組合，而是優化一組獨立的正向政策和一個全局的負向政策。<lb/>這減輕了在多獎勵政策優化過程中潛在的衝突，同時通過靈活的政策組合實現推理過程中的可控性。<lb/>在科學推理、工具使用推理和有用性-安全性對齊的實驗中，PRISM始終超越現有的多獎勵RL基準，並在推理時提供額外的可控性以進行偏好控制。
